note: Official domains allowed as citations (spec rule 2). One short reason per domain. Subdomains count. County domains count only for that county's own details.

domains.akleg.gov: Alaska State Legislature: Alaska Statutes and enacted bills (BASIS)
domains.alaska.gov: State of Alaska agencies, incl. Dept. of Commerce, Community & Economic Development (DCRA)
domains.muni.org: Municipality of Anchorage (borough-level taxing municipality), own details only
domains.fnsb.gov: Fairbanks North Star Borough, own details only
domains.revenue.alabama.gov: Alabama Department of Revenue (rules, property tax and state-held land pages)
domains.leginfo.legislature.ca.gov: California Legislative Information: official California codes and chaptered bills
domains.ca.gov: State of California agencies (e.g., State Controller sco.ca.gov, BOE, CDTFA)
domains.code.dccouncil.gov: Council of the District of Columbia: official DC Code
domains.dc.gov: District of Columbia government, incl. Office of Tax and Revenue (otr.cfo.dc.gov)
domains.capitol.hawaii.gov: Hawaii State Legislature: Hawaii Revised Statutes and session laws
domains.legislature.ky.gov: Kentucky General Assembly: Kentucky Revised Statutes and acts
domains.ky.gov: Commonwealth of Kentucky agencies (Dept. of Revenue)
domains.legis.la.gov: Louisiana State Legislature: Revised Statutes and acts
domains.la.gov: State of Louisiana agencies (Tax Commission, Revenue)
domains.legislature.maine.gov: Maine Legislature: Maine Revised Statutes and laws
domains.maine.gov: State of Maine agencies (Maine Revenue Services)
domains.kauai.gov: County of Kauai (Department of Finance, Real Property Tax), own details only
domains.honolulu.gov: City and County of Honolulu (Budget and Fiscal Services, Real Property), own details only
domains.mauicounty.gov: County of Maui (Real Property Tax Division), own details only
domains.sos.ms.gov: Mississippi Secretary of State: Public Lands Division (tax-forfeited lands) and administrative rules
domains.legislature.ms.gov: Mississippi Legislature (code access links and enacted bills)
domains.ls.state.ms.us: Mississippi Legislature bill status and enacted bill text
domains.ndlegis.gov: North Dakota Legislative Branch: North Dakota Century Code and session laws
domains.tax.newmexico.gov: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department (Property Tax Division delinquent auctions)
domains.biz.nm.gov: State of New Mexico Business Portal newsroom, publishing Taxation and Revenue Department press releases
domains.oklahomacounty.org: Oklahoma County (OK) Treasurer, own details only
domains.oktaxrolls.com: Oklahoma county treasurer sites hosted by TM Consulting (e.g., Delaware County Treasurer), each county's own details only
domains.oklegislature.gov: Oklahoma Legislature: bills, enacted acts and statute links
domains.oscn.net: Oklahoma State Courts Network: the official Oklahoma Statutes, linked by the Legislature
domains.sai.ok.gov: Oklahoma State Auditor and Inspector (county treasurer forms)
domains.palegis.us: Pennsylvania General Assembly: official consolidated and unconsolidated statutes and acts
domains.legis.state.pa.us: Pennsylvania General Assembly (legacy address, redirects to palegis.us)
domains.legis.texas.gov: Texas Legislative Council statute file server (tcss.legis.texas.gov) behind statutes.capitol.texas.gov, and Texas Legislature Online
domains.capitol.texas.gov: Texas Constitution and Statutes site (Texas Legislative Council)
